theme: Xử lý phàn nàn của khách

vocab.example: The client was disappointed because the report export failed three times.
vocab.example_vi: Khách hàng thất vọng vì chức năng xuất báo cáo bị lỗi ba lần.

vocab.meaning_vi: thời gian hệ thống ngừng hoạt động
vocab.example: Two hours of downtime on a Monday morning cost the client a lot of sales.
vocab.example_vi: Hai giờ hệ thống ngừng hoạt động vào sáng thứ Hai khiến khách hàng mất nhiều doanh số.

vocab.example: Please accept our apology for the trouble this has caused your team.
vocab.example_vi: Mong anh chị nhận lời xin lỗi của chúng tôi vì sự phiền toái đã gây ra cho đội của anh chị.

vocab.example: We will send you a full incident report by tomorrow afternoon.

vocab.example: Our engineers released a hotfix, and the booking page is working again.

vocab.example: For the next three months, your tickets will get priority support.

vocab.example: Our turnaround time for urgent tickets is now under two hours.

vocab.example: Fast and honest updates helped us regain trust with the client.
vocab.example_vi: Cập nhật nhanh và trung thực giúp chúng tôi lấy lại niềm tin của khách hàng.

listening.title: An angry call from a customer

lines.speaker: Mr. Tuan (Customer)
lines.text: Hello, Linh. I am very frustrated. Your booking system stopped working again this morning.

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Manager)
lines.text: I'm really sorry, Mr. Tuan. Can you tell me what time it happened?

lines.speaker: Mr. Tuan (Customer)
lines.text: Around eight. Our customers could not book for two hours. That is a lot of lost sales.

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Manager)
lines.text: I understand. I will escalate this to our technical manager right now.

lines.speaker: Mr. Tuan (Customer)
lines.text: This is the second time this month. I want to know the root cause.

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Manager)
lines.text: Of course. Our team will send you a full incident report by tomorrow afternoon.

lines.speaker: Mr. Tuan (Customer)
lines.text: And what about the lost sales? I expect some compensation.

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Manager)
lines.text: I will discuss it with my director. As a goodwill gesture, we can give you one month free.

lines.speaker: Mr. Tuan (Customer)
lines.text: Okay, that helps. But please make sure it does not happen again.

lines.speaker: Linh (Account Manager)
lines.text: I promise. I will call you every day this week with an update.

questions.q: How long could customers not make bookings?
When will Mr. Tuan receive the full report?
What does Linh offer as a goodwill gesture?

shadowing: I'm really sorry about this. I understand why you are so frustrated.
Let me escalate this to our technical team and call you back within an hour.
We have released a hotfix, and the booking page is working again now.
As a goodwill gesture, we would like to offer you one month of free service.
I'll send you a short update every day until the problem is fully solved.
